anchors.anchor: “Organizing all this into different piles based on color.”
Can you go to Hell for ogling a Grim Reaper?
I’m guessing not, but it still feels wrong.
“You said you were making party favors,” he reminds me.
“Yes!” I chirp even as my heart rate triples.
Though I’m probably just splitting hairs.
This is the only way I had time for him today.
I’m still stunned he agreed to it so easily.
